title: Returns, refunds and workshop warranty, version 1

clauses.1.1: These terms apply to orders placed while this version is in force. Your order confirmation names the version and its fingerprint.
clauses.2.1: Changed your mind? Return unused parts in their original packaging within 30 days of delivery. We refund the item price, less the restocking fee in clause 2.3.
clauses.2.2: You arrange and pay for return shipping on change-of-mind returns.
clauses.2.3: A restocking fee of 10% of the item price applies to change-of-mind returns.
clauses.3.1: If a part arrives damaged, tell us within 14 days of delivery and send a photo. We refund the item and the delivery charge or send a replacement, and we pay return shipping.
clauses.3.2: If we send the wrong part, tell us within 30 days of delivery. We refund the item and the delivery charge or send the right part, and we pay return shipping.
clauses.3.3: Workshop warranty: if a wheel build or part fails within 730 days of delivery under normal use, we repair it, replace it or refund it. We pay return shipping.
clauses.3.4: If your order has not arrived 10 days after dispatch, we refund the item and the delivery charge or send it again.
clauses.4.1: Custom wheel builds and parts cut to your measurements are made to order. They cannot be returned because you changed your mind. Faults are covered by clause 3.3.
clauses.5.1: If you disagree with how we applied these terms, you can take the case to the Open Resolution Desk procedure (ord/1). We follow its computed outcome for these terms. These terms do not limit any rights you have under the law.
